verification_scope: Source-backed static capability ledger. It does not attest a live provider client, a current installation, native discovery, provider-session resumption, or an ended-turn wake.

office.transport: local filesystem plus owner-only Windows named-pipe wake; no network listener, port, tunnel, or remote transport

E-TEST-STDIO-TOOLS.scope: Agent Office stdio server tool listing only; not native client discovery.

E-TEST-INSTALLER-STDIO.scope: Synthetic installed MCP registration starts the local server; not a live Codex or Claude discovery receipt.

E-TEST-STDIO-EXCHANGE.scope: Two synthetic local stdio MCP servers exchange messages and wake waits; not provider-session resumption.

E-TEST-NO-NETWORK.scope: Local Office transport owns no network socket.

E-EVIDENCE-NO-NETWORK-R9.scope: Fresh committed-origin receipt binds child-side python -I isolation, probe hash, live MCP child PIDs and netstat sampling; it is not provider-client discovery evidence.

E-INSTALLER-NATIVE-CANDIDATES.scope: Installer configuration candidates for Claude and Codex only; neither configuration nor a copied skill proves native discovery.

E-INSTALLER-SKILL-TARGETS.scope: Instruction distribution target only. It is expressly insufficient to prove native MCP discovery or a successful client call.

E-README-LOCAL-CLI.section: Agent Office and dedicated local installer
E-README-LOCAL-CLI.scope: Documents the local Office home, wrapper, CLI, and stdio MCP entrypoint.

E-README-QWEN-CLI-FALLBACK.scope: Documents the bounded CLI wait fallback for headless Qwen Code; no Qwen session test is claimed.

E-README-PROGRESS-CANCEL.scope: Documents local MCP progress and cancellation dispatch only; it does not prove a provider client consumes either feature.

E-README-ENDED-TURN.scope: Explicitly excludes provider-session resume, automatic new turns, and ended-turn self-wake.

E-README-NO-HOOK.scope: No Office hook is activated and no native action-event capture is claimed.

E-README-IDENTITY.scope: One local Windows user is a warning-only trust assumption; there is no local authentication of agent identity.

E-README-REMOTE-HERMES.scope: Remote Hermes remains uncontacted and is not installed, configured, inferred, or activated.

E-RUNTIME-NO-LIVE-RECEIPT.scope: No runtime-specific live client receipt is present in this matrix.

discovery.basis: The local stdio server can list its tools after it has been started. This is not native discovery by a provider runtime.

send_read.basis: Synthetic local stdio MCP servers exchange durable Office messages in both directions.

pending_wait.basis: A pending local Office wait wakes after an Office message.

progress_cancel.basis: The local server documents progress and cancellation dispatch, but this ledger has no independent provider-client consumption receipt.

provider_session_resume.basis: Office messaging does not resume a provider session.

new_turn.basis: Office has no scheduler or automatic provider-turn launcher.

action_event_capture.basis: Office does not activate a native hook or consume provider action events.

ended_turn_wake.basis: A completed model turn cannot wake itself through Office.
